sources.title: Essentialism: The Disciplined Pursuit of Less
The 7 Habits of Highly Effective People

concepts.definition: The disciplined pursuit of less: deciding what is essential, removing the rest and making the essential easy.
A small share of causes tends to produce a large share of results.

questions.q: What is the core idea of essentialism?
questions.a: Do less but better: decide what is essential, remove the rest and make the essential easy.

questions.q: Why should the vital few be re-evaluated?
questions.a: The most valuable activities change with goals and circumstances.
